name: Skeleton
flavour: It does not know it is dead. It knows you are not.
art_prompt: a skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: warm ivory bone with soft warm beige shading, clean with no stains, a slightly large skull with big dark hollow eye sockets and a row of square teeth, a clear ribcage, spine and pelvis, slim arm and leg bones with rounded joints, bony hands and feet, no clothes, no weapon, both arms stretched straight out in front at shoulder height like a sleepwalking zombie, the bony hands reaching forward, standing and facing the viewer
motion: a skeleton walking slowly with both arms stretched straight out in front like a zombie
back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the skull, the spine running down between the shoulder blades, the back of the ribcage and the pelvis, both arms raised straight out in front so only the shoulders and upper arms show, no face
dead_hint: collapsed into a low loose heap of bones, dead: every bone fallen into one flat pile, the skull resting on top, the ribcage broken apart, arm bones, leg bones, feet and vertebrae all jumbled inside the pile with nothing sticking out below it; the pile sits on nothing, with no ground, no sand, no dirt patch and no shadow under it
doc: The crowd since pass 45: bare bones walking in with their arms at their sides, five to a pack, half a slot each against the cap. Everything else is measured against it. It falls over backwards when it dies.

SK-A.note: arms down at its sides on Mixamo's plain walk; it falls over sideways and lies whole (pass 45); a thin dark-brown outline

recipe.art_prompt: a skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: warm ivory bone with soft warm beige shading, clean with no stains, a slightly large skull with big dark hollow eye sockets and a row of square teeth, a clear ribcage, spine and pelvis, slim arm and leg bones with rounded joints, bony hands and feet, no clothes, no weapon, both arms hanging relaxed straight down at its sides, standing upright and facing the viewer
recipe.back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the skull, the spine running down between the shoulder blades, the back of the ribcage and the pelvis, both arms hanging straight down at its sides, no face
recipe.dead_hint: fallen over and lying on the ground on its side, dead and still in one piece: the whole body stretched out flat and sideways across the picture, the skull on the left side and the feet on the right side, the arms limp along the body, every bone connected, no clothes
recipe.gait: walking in place on the spot at a slow steady pace, both arms swinging gently at its sides
recipe.motion: a skeleton walking slowly with its arms at its sides
recipe.anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, extra skulls, two heads, extra hands, arms stretched out in front, a weapon appearing or changing

SK-B.note: a bandit skeleton (the poncho / cape covers the ribcage) on a light scurrying run, a small knife held low; it dies on the Falling Back Death clip

recipe.art_prompt: a skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: warm ivory bone with soft warm beige shading, clean with no stains, a slightly large skull with big dark hollow eye sockets and a row of square teeth, a ragged brown poncho draped over its shoulders and chest covering the ribcage, a battered flat-brimmed dark hat on its skull, bare bone arms and legs, a small bone-handled knife held low in one hand down at its side, the other arm hanging at its side, standing and facing the viewer
recipe.back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the hat and the poncho hanging over its back, both arms hanging down at its sides, the small knife in the same hand, no face
recipe.dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: its body stretched out sideways across the picture with the skull on the left and the feet on the right, arms flopped out limp, the small knife lying beside its open hand; it lies on nothing, with no ground and no shadow under it
recipe.gait: jogging in place on the spot with a light quick scurrying run, holding the same small bone-handled knife low in one hand the whole time
recipe.motion: a skeleton jogging lightly with a small knife held low
recipe.anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, extra skulls, two heads, extra hands, arms stretched out in front, a weapon appearing or changing

SK-C.note: a chunky cartoon skeleton with thick rounded bones and no gaps; a lighter warm-grey outline. Pass 131: both walks painted again on the big-guy swagger the D looks walk on (Mixamo bigguy_walking), retargeted in Blender to this painting's short, wide frame (tools/pose_driver.py body=...: front bigguy_chunky2, back bigguy_chunky3_spread with broader shoulders, a shorter neck and the wrists pushed clear of the body); it stands on its painting (stand: still); the paintings, the icon and the death are as they were, the old strip is in tools/dl/p131/SKEL/before/

recipe.art_prompt: a chunky cartoon skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: thick heavy rounded ivory bones with soft warm beige shading, a big round skull with a wide square jaw and big dark eye sockets, a broad solid barrel ribcage with the ribs fused into one shape and no gaps between them, short thick arms and legs, big rounded bony fists, no clothes, no weapon, standing in a slight crouch with its fists held low at its sides, facing the viewer
recipe.back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the big round skull, the thick spine and the broad solid back of the ribcage, the thick arms hanging at its sides, no face
recipe.dead_hint: collapsed into a low heap of thick cartoon bones, dead: the big skull resting on top of a short pile of thick rounded bones, nothing sticking out below it; the pile sits on nothing, with no ground, no sand and no shadow under it
recipe.motion: a chunky heavy skeleton with thick rounded bones walking with a heavy swagger, keeping the same broad solid ribcage, thick limbs and big round skull the whole time
recipe.anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, extra skulls, two heads, extra hands, arms stretched out in front, a weapon appearing or changing, arms folded, arms crossed over the chest, thin bones, slender limbs, a narrow ribcage, the figure shrinking
recipe.gait: swaggering in place on the spot with a heavy rolling walk, its thick arms swinging its big bony fists low beside its hips

SK-D.note: a swaggering big-guy walk with a short rusty hatchet (the knight: a round shield on one arm); it dies on the Falling Back Death clip; the standard dark outline

recipe.art_prompt: a skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: warm ivory bone with soft warm beige shading, clean with no stains, a slightly large skull with big dark hollow eye sockets and a row of square teeth, a clear ribcage, spine and pelvis, slim arm and leg bones with rounded joints, bony hands and feet, no clothes, a rusted iron pauldron strapped over one shoulder, a short rusty hatchet held down at its side in one hand, the other arm hanging at its side, standing with its shoulders squared and facing the viewer
recipe.back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the skull, the spine running down between the shoulder blades, the back of the ribcage and the pelvis, both arms hanging down at its sides, the rusted pauldron on the same shoulder and the hatchet in the same hand, no face
recipe.dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: its body stretched out sideways across the picture with the skull on the left and the feet on the right, arms flopped out limp, the hatchet lying beside its open hand; it lies on nothing, with no ground and no shadow under it
recipe.gait: swaggering in place on the spot with a heavy rolling walk, the same short rusty hatchet held down at its side in one hand the whole time, the hatchet keeps its exact shape and never changes hands
recipe.motion: a skeleton walking with a heavy swagger
recipe.anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, extra skulls, two heads, extra hands, arms stretched out in front, a weapon appearing or changing

SK-E.note: the SK-A skeleton with dark blue bones (pass 54, Garry: a dark-blue version of my favourite skeletons; the same walk, the same fall); a frame-by-frame tint of the SK-A strip (tools/recolour_strip.py --mode tint)
